text: Which protein kinases are expressed in every brain region?
plan: Protein class: Enzymes / Kinases AND Brain region category (RNA): any / Detected in all
understanding: Identify genes classified as protein kinases that have RNA distribution/expression across all brain regions.

trail.why: Protein kinases fall under the 'Enzymes' class and are specifically categorized under the 'Kinases' subclass.
"Detected in all" is explicitly defined as detected in every region of the dataset, and leaving Level 1 unrestricted applies this condition across all brain regions.

requirements.why: This field classifies genes into subclasses such as kinases under enzymes.
This field defines RNA specificity and distribution categories across human brain regions (e.g., expressed in all).
